For visual and UI work in this repo, follow `AGENTS.md` at the repo root. It is the single source of instructions for every agent: what to load (always `core/principles.md` and `core/critique-loop.md`, then only the modules the job needs) and how to run the job (read the ask, brief, render the real output, critique against rule IDs, at most 3 verified fixes per round, deliver with a done / not done list). Install steps for other projects: `docs/install.md`.
